origine_fr: Le bois 木 et 仓, qui donnait le son mais se lit cāng. Au départ, 枪 est un pieu pointu pour se défendre. Le bâton pointu est devenu « la lance », puis « le fusil ».
origine_en: Wood 木 with 仓, which gave the sound but is read cāng. At first, 枪 was a pointed stake to fend people off. The pointed stick became “the spear”, then “the gun”.

phrase.fr: Un coup de feu a retenti au loin.
phrase.en: The sound of gunfire came from far away.
